verdict.rationale: Viam documents a cloud-hosted simulated environment in its setup wizard for configuring and testing before hardware arrives, and a Viam 101 course that builds a palletizing cell in simulation with no hardware. The RDK also ships a fake/dummy configuration. Nothing describes realistic physics or sensor models, so this covers only the 'before touching hardware' part. missing for 10: documented physics engine/realistic dynamics, realistic sensor models (noise, camera/lidar simulation), environment modeling depth, independent or hands-on corroboration of simulation fidelity

support.subject: As a robotics engineer, I can simulate my robot and its environment with realistic physics and sensor models before touching hardware

citations.quote: If you don't have your hardware yet, the setup wizard can also run your machine in a simulated environment in the cloud, so you can start configuring and testing right away.
Build a palletizing cell in simulation and learn the core concepts behind every Viam machine. 90 minutes · No hardware required
Example with a dummy configuration: `go run ./web/cmd/server -config etc/configs/fake.json`.
